`git status` is still clean, so nothing was added to the repo. The script that draws the chart is at `/tmp/acme-plot/plot.py`, also outside the repo. macOS may delete files in `/tmp` eventually, so copy the script somewhere else if you want to keep it.

The chart shows one bar per month for 2026. Labels mark the first month (January, $41.2k) and the highest month (December, $71.8k). The subtitle gives the year's total (about $0.65M) and the January-to-December growth (+74%). Revenue grows almost every month, with small drops in February, June and October.
